reconstructed_steps.text: Let K be nontrivially valued and let X/K be the actual smooth geometrically integral projective curve with actual ample rational L of raw degree V>0. Choose mL globally generated and a finite K-basis of H0(X,mL). Its equal-weight pure FS metric theta_K is genuine. Over C=completed algebraic closure, theta_C remains pure FS and is invariant under the actual compact Galois action: the sections are defined over K and every automorphism is isometric.

BE5.14 gives a projective globally generated rational model inducing theta_C. For this application C is already algebraically closed with divisible value group and the metric is already pure, so no additional value-group enlargement is needed in BE8.11. Use a reduced dominating model preserving the metric. Its raw curve formula is MA(theta_C)=sum_Y deg(M|Y) delta_xY, with rational bundle scaling retained. Each nonzero coefficient is positive, and the total is exactly V by the accepted genuine operator/mass result O217. Let S be the nonempty finite set of positive-mass points. This is the support of an ACTUAL measure, not a chosen abstract skeleton.

BE4.8/4.9 and GM A.1-A.3 identify these model Shilov points with actual divisorial points. On the smooth one-dimensional analytic curve their residue transcendence degree over the algebraically closed residue field is one (GM A.5 and the model generic-point description). The Abhyankar inequality leaves relative rational value rank zero; divisibility of the base value group then makes every new value already a base value. Thus these are actual type-II points. The full printed source unit is read, but its generated Berkovich/GRW/CLD dependencies are not all recursively read or made grants by this record.

Functoriality of the intrinsic actual Monge-Ampere operator under the isometric semilinear action, together with invariance of theta_C, makes this finite positive Radon measure G-invariant. For each g, support(g_*MA(theta_C))=g(S), so g(S)=S. Hence ANY y in S has a finite actual orbit O=G.y, without descending a chosen semistable model or invoking stable reduction over a finite algebraic extension. This establishes the proposed R5 finite-orbit input once the stated pure-FS/model/support applications are independently verified.

Only AFTER actual all-genus atomic metrics and every-solution uniqueness have been proved using R1-R4, solve MA(phi_y)=V delta_y on the given upstairs bundle for each y in O and normalize relative to invariant theta_C by sup(phi_y-theta_C)=0. Equivariance and every-solution uniqueness force g.phi_y=phi_g(y). The finite arithmetic average is continuous psh and invariant. In dimension one, the actual curvature operator is affine, so its measure is (V/|O|)sum_O delta_y. Apply accepted D214 to descend this CONTINUOUS invariant metric and its actual measure. All points of O map to one downstairs xi, giving raw mass V delta_xi. This does not average arbitrary singular metrics or multiply volume by an extension degree.

A single norming-anchor use of N220 additionally requires proving that EVERY genuine FS potential relative to the descended atomic reference takes its maximum at xi. Use an actual common full-cycle core for the reference/FS data, the positive-curvature maximum principle and formal-disc frame monotonicity. That proof is not supplied by finite-orbit existence alone. Therefore this route simplifies R5 but does not declare the full curve criterion, arbitrary-target equation, norming property or higher-dimensional original solved.
